events.text: Ayala Corporation committed to achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, announced by President & CEO Fernando Zobel de Ayala during the group's Integrated Corporate Governance, Risk Management, and Sustainability Summit.
Ayala Corporation filed its Integrated Annual Corporate Governance Report for the fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2024, with SEC Identification Number 34218.
ACEN earmarked P72 billion for capital expenditures in 2024, with P40 billion directed to its Philippine power assets including the expansion of the 283 MW San Marcelino solar project.
On Aug. 9, BPI raised P33.7 billion from its initial P5 billion offering of Peso-denominated fixed-rate Sustainable, Environmental, and Equitable Development bonds.
ACEN had ~3,700 MW attributable capacity in the Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and Australia, with a renewable share of 93%.

In a Philippine Stock Exchange report dated Nov.14, 2025, ACEN's Ace Enexor disclosed the discontinuation of the proposed Batangas Clean Energy (BCE) Project, aligning with ACEN's 'strategic shift toward renewable energy generation'.
